# hotd: seeds for the SCSP sound board's 68000 (m2sndrecomp --scsp). Addresses only, our own analysis
# (scripts/snd_table_scan.py and the bring-up stops). Computed jumps "lea (d,PC,Dn),An; jmp (An)": tables of
# bra entries at 0x600298 (8 x 2), 0x600710, 0x6028c8, 0x602b00 (8 x 4); unrolled copy and clear runs
# entered anywhere (Duff's device) at 0x601c44 (move.l) and 0x601d4c (clr.l): every instruction a seed.
# Offset tables "move.w (tbl,PC,Xn),Dn; jmp (tbl,PC,Dn)" (scripts/snd_table_scan.py): every target a seed.
